decision: VnExpress production discovery must use ordinary public HTTP/HTML/XML/RSS and public Wayback replay HTML only; CDX/API endpoints are not production eligible.
basis: Project no-API operational constraint and successful VnExpress pilot.

decision: VnExpress historical child sitemap URLs are not used as a historical production source because tested child URLs return HTTP 302 to the VnExpress homepage rather than XML.
basis: 18/18 pilot child probes returned 302; direct diagnostic confirmed redirect destination https://vnexpress.net.

decision: requested_archive_datetime is a replay probe target only. archive_datetime returned by the archive is the authoritative observation-time provenance for Wayback replay observations.
basis: Pilot captures showed nonzero drift, including approximately +32 and +43 days for historical /so-hoa probes.

decision: Use configured archive target days 1 and 15 of each month for the Stage 4.3 VnExpress production component. Preserve actual archive_datetime and do not infer missing captures or monthly coverage from requested target dates.
basis: Bounded pilot across 2025-06, 2025-12, 2026-04 and 2026-08 produced 8/8 parseable compliant replay captures; sampling is an operational discovery policy, not a claim of exact monthly snapshot availability.

decision: The aggregate_sha256 value locked in config/stage_4_3.yaml is retained unchanged as a legacy opaque guard. It could not be reproduced from the current 108 Tuoi Tre discovered_urls.parquet files using the tested aggregate-hash constructions. The current immutable inventory uses the documented deterministic relative-path plus per-file SHA256 construction recorded in the Tuoi Tre historical merge manifest.
basis: 108 blocks and 121285 observations were independently validated. The reproducible aggregate_input_sha256 is 3b8a14bb1aeee7c84a81e6a5e54049ddf26135b44e09252bad9cec3011cc56cd. No Tuoi Tre historical block was rerun or overwritten.

change: Supersede ADR 0006 placeholder and hash re-anchoring permission; preserve original protocol and source-lock hashes for all three roles.
reason: User explicitly selected preserving the original baseline during remediation planning.
scientific_impact: Missing or substituted source originals remain blocking; no population, ontology or temporal semantics changed.
requires_reprocess: No production execution in this checkpoint; any later run certified against substituted sources requires invalidation assessment and a new validated run.
forbidden_downstream_evidence_checked: Decision based solely on source authority and user instruction; no downstream model outcomes used.
